title: Badminton
subject: One athletic badminton player at the decisive instant of a powerful smash, body twisted dynamically toward the shuttle
environment: A recognisable indoor badminton court with net, correct court lines, and subdued gym background
recognition_anchors: exactly one shuttlecock frozen in flight
avoid: real-world brand logos or readable apparel text
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 recognition. flux-2/edit test hallucinated a real sportswear logo on the shorts — reinforced with explicit avoid + global negative.
composition: Keep the player as the single hero; isolate the shuttlecock against clean negative space above or near the net.
camera: Low three-quarter court-side medium-wide action angle, close enough that racket and shuttlecock are unmistakable.
lighting: Cinematic indoor arena lighting with cool court tones and warm edge highlights; illustrated rather than photographic.
palette: teal-blue court tones with warm gold highlights

title: Bouldering
subject: One climber making a dynamic move on a steep indoor bouldering wall, using hands and climbing shoes on clearly visible holds, with no rope or harness
environment: A modern bouldering gym with colorful climbing holds and thick crash mats clearly visible below; other walls remain soft and secondary
recognition_anchors: steep bouldering wall with colored holds
avoid: outdoor rock face mixed with indoor holds
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 recognition, best-in-batch composition. No override needed.
composition: The climber and wall fill most of the card; show body tension and the next hold clearly while keeping the crash mat visible enough to identify bouldering.
camera: Side three-quarter medium-wide angle, slightly low but not implying dangerous cliff-scale height.
lighting: Directional gym light that reveals chalk, wall texture, and muscle tension with premium illustrated contrast.
palette: warm wall tones with colorful holds and cool shadow separation

title: Sushi
subject: An elegant arrangement of premium nigiri and rolls on a dark ceramic plate, one hand placing a final piece
environment: Warm Japanese izakaya dining setting with glowing paper lanterns
avoid: multiple unrelated dishes competing for focus
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, composition slightly busy with a second background diner; flagship override simplifies to one hand + plate.
composition: One premium plate is the hero; exactly one hand completes or reaches toward the dish while the background stays quiet.
lighting: Warm lantern-like food lighting with crisp fish/rice texture.
palette: deep ceramic neutrals, salmon/coral highlights, warm amber background

title: Japan
subject: A traveler with a small backpack walking through a coherent traditional Japanese machiya street at blue-gold hour
environment: Wooden machiya facades, unlettered paper lanterns and noren-like fabric, cherry blossoms, and a distant pagoda silhouette within one believable streetscape
notes: Hard case: risk of reading as generic old-town travel without the mountain + blossom combo. Both anchors kept mandatory.
composition: The traveler occupies the near foreground while the Japanese street remains the clear destination identity; avoid montage-like landmark stacking.
lighting: Warm lantern glow balanced with cool evening ambience, polished illustrated rendering.
palette: warm amber lanterns, soft blossom pink, deep indigo evening tones

title: Piano
subject: A pianist seated at a glossy grand piano mid-performance, hands captured mid-motion on the keys
environment: Softly lit room or small stage, warm spotlight, city lights blurred through a window behind
avoid: generic concert crowd overwhelming the performer
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5; composition slightly tight/side-profile, consider pulling back a touch in v2.
composition: Show enough of the grand piano body and keyboard to read instantly while keeping the performer emotionally present.
camera: Three-quarter medium hero shot, slightly pulled back rather than tight side-profile.
lighting: Warm focused performance key light with restrained city or venue bokeh.
palette: deep piano blacks with warm gold highlights and subtle cool background

title: Road Trip
subject: A car driving along a winding coastal or mountain road at golden hour, seen from a dramatic elevated angle
environment: Open coastal cliffside landscape stretching to the horizon, golden-hour sky
recognition_anchors: car on a winding open road
avoid: parked car with no journey feeling
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5; style drift flagged — slightly more photoreal/lens-flare than the rest of the set, tone down toward painterly rendering in v2.
composition: Use the winding road as a strong leading line from one moving car toward the open destination; the car must remain large enough to read.
camera: Elevated three-quarter wide view, not a drone-like distant postcard.
lighting: Golden-hour illustrated light without heavy photographic lens flare.
palette: sunlit warm landscape with teal/cool atmospheric depth

title: Coffee
subject: A steaming cup of latte-art coffee held in both hands at a wooden cafe table
environment: Cozy cafe interior, soft window light, blurred fellow patrons in the background
avoid: isolated mug on a blank table
generic stock cafe with no human warmth
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, solid drink_ritual execution. No override needed.
composition: Hands and the coffee cup form one intimate focal cluster; the café is supportive, not the subject.
lighting: Soft warm window/café light with visible steam and crisp latte-art detail.
palette: coffee browns, cream foam, warm wood, muted teal/green accents

title: AI
subject: A human creator actively guiding an AI-assisted visual creation workflow; on the main display one source sketch or image is visibly transforming into several coherent generated visual variations, with a subtle node/network transformation diagram on a secondary display
environment: Modern creative studio at night with one primary workstation and city lights softly outside; screens contain imagery and diagrams but no readable text or code
recognition_anchors: one source visual transforming into multiple generated variants
notes: Pilot v1 weakest hobby (4.0/5) — read as generic 'coder at night'. Subject rewritten so a generative image on-screen is the primary recognition anchor.
composition: Keep the person, source-to-variations transformation, and active human input in one clear visual story; avoid generic programmer imagery.
camera: Tight over-shoulder medium shot so the generative transformation on the primary display is readable.
lighting: Cool screen light balanced by warm human/studio accents; no cyberpunk overload.
palette: controlled teal/blue technology tones with warm skin and amber studio accents

title: Photography
subject: A photographer actively raising a camera to the eye and composing a shot, with the camera body and lens prominent in the foreground
environment: A scenic location remains visible but deliberately secondary and softer than the photographer and camera
notes: Hard case: visually overlaps with travel_vista (Japan, Road Trip). v2 should crop tighter on photographer + camera and de-emphasize the landscape.
composition: The photographer should occupy roughly half the frame; the act of framing/capturing is the hero, not the landscape.
camera: Tight over-shoulder or three-quarter medium shot focused on camera-to-eye interaction.
lighting: Natural directional light with crisp camera/lens detail and restrained background atmosphere.
palette: natural cinematic tones with clean subject/background separation

title: Board Games
subject: A group of four friends gathered closely around a table, mid-play on a richly detailed tabletop board game
environment: Warm lamp-lit living room at night, dice and pieces mid-move on the board
recognition_anchors: central game board with pieces and dice
avoid: generic dinner party with no visible game
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5 — best-in-batch social warmth. Reference execution for group_play archetype, no override needed.
composition: Show a genuine reaction to a move: faces, hands, dice/pieces, and the central board all remain readable.
camera: Intimate eye-level or slightly elevated medium shot around the table.
lighting: Warm pooled lamp light centered on the board and players.
palette: warm amber/social interior tones with colorful game pieces

title: Cinema
subject: The interior of a cinema theatre viewed from behind the seated audience; the large screen displays a clearly narrative fictional movie moment, not a musician or stage performance
environment: Cinema seats and architectural cues with projector light through subtle haze; the screen is the primary focal source
recognition_anchors: large movie screen with a narrative scene
must_include: movie screen with a legible fictional scene
avoid: musician, guitar, microphone, or live-performance cue dominating the screen
notes: Pilot v1 attempt 1 was 4/5 (abstract screen, reroll trigger); attempt 2 hit 5/5 once the screen showed a legible scene. Fix is now baked into the base recipe.
composition: Screen and audience must unmistakably read as movie-going. The fictional screen scene should contain a subject and setting but no recognisable franchise or copyrighted character.
camera: Centered or slightly off-center audience perspective, medium-wide.
lighting: Screen light spills onto audience silhouettes while theatre details remain readable.
palette: deep theatre shadows with vivid but controlled screen color

title: Camping
subject: Two friends seated beside a crackling campfire next to one clearly visible glowing tent in a forest clearing
environment: Night forest and distant mountain silhouette under a star-filled sky, with the campsite remaining the visual anchor
notes: Pilot v1: 4.5/5 — correctly recognized but plainest composition in its archetype group; v2 should push more foreground firelight/warmth for desirability.
composition: Warm campfire and tent dominate the foreground/midground; people create belonging while the stars/mountains support rather than replace the hobby.
camera: Human-height medium-wide campsite view, close enough to read gear and faces/silhouettes.
lighting: Strong warm fire/tent glow against cool blue night ambience.
palette: amber firelight, warm tent glow, deep blue night, restrained star highlights

title: Pottery
subject: A potter's hands shaping wet clay on a spinning pottery wheel
environment: Sunlit ceramics studio, shelves of finished glazed pieces softly blurred in the background
avoid: finished pots only, no wheel/process visible
notes: Pilot v1: 5/5, reference execution for creative_studio archetype. No override needed.
composition: Hands, spinning clay, water, and the forming vessel dominate the scene; studio shelves remain soft context.
camera: Close-medium process view angled across the wheel.
lighting: Warm sunlit studio light revealing wet clay texture.
palette: earthy clay tones, warm wood, soft ceramic glaze accents

title: Running
subject: One runner captured in a clear powerful running stride, feet and arm swing showing unmistakable forward pace
environment: A simple riverside, park, or urban running path at early morning with the background deliberately secondary
recognition_anchors: clear running stride with airborne or push-off phase
must_include: one runner in unmistakable running stride
notes: Pilot v1: 4.5/5 — style drift toward photoreal lens-flare travel-poster look; v2 should pull rendering back toward the painterly baseline used by Badminton/Bouldering.
composition: The runner fills most of the frame; use direction and posture for momentum rather than scenic spectacle.
camera: Side-tracking medium shot at runner height.
lighting: Clean early-morning directional light with no heavy lens flare; painterly illustrated finish rather than sports-stock photography.
palette: cool morning environment with warm skin/sun highlights

title: LEGO
subject: Hands actively assembling one intricate colorful interlocking plastic-brick model, with one large studded brick element in sharp foreground focus
environment: Bright tabletop building workspace with a small amount of sorted brick storage softly behind
must_include: studded interlocking bricks in clear focus
avoid: generic architecture model with no visible brick geometry
notes: Pilot v1: 4.75/5, recognition scored 4/5 — v2 pulls a single large stud-textured brick/minifigure into sharp foreground focus per pilot report recommendation.
composition: The active build is the hero; one large studded element provides instant recognition while the broader model shows creative ambition.
lighting: Bright premium tabletop light with crisp stud and hand detail.
palette: colorful brick accents against a clean warm-neutral workspace
